The designer should add an appropriate fit or tolerance class to D4 that accounts for the anodize thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a fit or tolerance callout to dimension D4 suitable for the guide bush function and compatible with the specified anodizing."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"NOTE : (English) # MATERIAL: AL HE30 # FINISH: SELF-ANODIZING # MACHINING: 3.2( 3.2) # WEIGHT(Kg ): 0.11 kg"}],"comment":"Note N3 (page 1) specifies self-anodizing but no dimension on the drawing allows for the plating/coating thickness buildup, which will alter the final size of tight fits such as the guide bore. The designer must either specify pre-coating machining allowances or state that dimensions apply after coating.","recommended_correction":"Add notes or dimensional allowances indicating whether sizes apply before or after anodizing, and account for coating thickness on any tight-fit features."}]}
